description: Readings of one biometric over a date range, in the unit given (default: the account’s display unit for weight, the metric’s first unit otherwise). Cronometer averages several readings on one day here; get_diary lists each with its id.

end_date.description: A date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday", or "N days ago" (resolved in the diary timezone).

start_date.description: A date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday", or "N days ago" (resolved in the diary timezone).

unit_id.description: A Cronometer id from an earlier tool result.
